messages.subject: Sustainability & Energy Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Lindo,

Intelligent Employment's work across ESG, low-carbon solutions and renewable energy aligns closely with my leadership background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where sustainability and energy-transition strategy must connect regulation, stakeholders and measurable execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
